title: 10 technical talks I’m excited about at GitHub Universe 2026
Accessibility statements highlighted on repository overview
summary: You can now find an ACCESSIBILITY.md file in your repository’s root, the .github/ directory, or the docs/ directory highlighted on the repository overview.[^c-6a6b7519d1] You can also add or propose an accessibility statement from a public repository’s Community Standards page.[^c-ad61bad2cd]

title: Actions Runner Controller release 0.15.0
summary: GitHub Actions Runner Controller 0.15.0 includes reliability, scalability, and observability improvements for runner scale sets.[^c-c4732d5d33]

title: GitHub async merge API generally available
summary: You can now use the generally available GitHub async merge API to merge individual or stacked pull requests, add pull requests to a merge queue, or merge pull requests directly.[^c-73d8373cde]

title: New dashboard experience now the default
summary: The new dashboard experience, previously available as a feature preview, is now the default view for everyone.[^c-1d21447cb2] The redesigned dashboard helps you focus on the work that matters most and makes it easier to find and act on what you need next.[^c-bb9b65e8c3]

title: Dynamic workflows in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app
summary: Dynamic workflows are now available in Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and the GitHub Copilot SDK.[^c-ee4860031d]

title: Code coverage uploads no longer fail CI for new branches
summary: Code coverage uploads from the GitHub Code Quality upload-code-coverage action no longer fail CI when you push a branch that doesn’t yet have an open pull request.[^c-3010b9f923] Previously, the coverage API required a pull request number for any push to a non-default branch.[^c-d5edf02066]

title: Scheduled code scanning skips inactive repositories
summary: Weekly scheduled scans for code scanning default setup and GitHub Code Quality now start only after a push or pull request triggers an analysis, rather than counting every kind of scan as recent activity.[^c-1d50d7bd36] Previously, activity for a repository was based on any unscheduled scan, including the one-time validation scan that runs when you first enable default setup and scans triggered by a change in detected languages.[^c-d37373938e]

title: Actions retention now covers checks, runs, and statuses
GitHub Copilot in VS Code, September 2026 releases
GitHub Actions: macOS 14 runner image retirement
summary: The macOS 14 runner image will be retired on November 2, 2026.[^c-e7810812e5]

title: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
summary: Computer use is now available in public preview in GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app on macOS and Windows.[^c-d97500e658] Copilot can interact with desktop applications on your behalf (e.g., reading accessible app content and visual context, clicking controls, entering and editing text, pressing keys, scrolling, dragging, and navigating workflows across applications).[^c-4266c73f3a]

title: Structured forms for private vulnerability reports
summary: Private vulnerability reports can now use a structured form that asks reporters for the details you need to assess a vulnerability, including a reproducible proof of concept.[^c-38140a6b82] A single free-text box made it easy to submit low-quality or AI-generated reports and hard for you to find the signal in them.[^c-4e3784ef03]

title: Rate limits for private vulnerability reports
AI is changing developer work. Here are three skills to strengthen.
summary: Learn to direct AI agents, critically review their output, and keep technical judgment at the center of your workflow.[^c-6b64ce0ee8] AI is changing how developers work and apply their skills.[^c-81d1e9cc78] Writing code is still essential, but developers increasingly need to know how to direct AI, evaluate its output, communicate tradeoffs, and make sound technical decisions.[^c-caeb8a779c]

title: Repository security advisory comments API in public preview
summary: You can now read, add, and edit comments on repository security advisories using the REST API, including advisories created from private vulnerability reports.[^c-080b6dbb9f] Until now, the discussion on an advisory was only reachable in the web UI, even though it often holds the most useful triage context on a vulnerability report.[^c-e1606d5f81]

title: Confidential comments on repository security advisories
summary: You can now post confidential comments on repository security advisories.[^c-bf2e8089de] Confidential comments are visible only to people with write access to the repository, so you can discuss a report with your team without the reporter or other invited collaborators seeing it.[^c-c20ffbb1db] Previously, every comment on an advisory was visible to all of its collaborators, including the reporter.[^c-002ac4a26e]

title: New fields for SecurityAdvisory GraphQL API
summary: You can now read more of the GitHub Advisory Database directly from the GraphQL API without falling back to the REST API.[^c-9d9a87ecbc]

title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
summary: As of today, October 2, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).[^c-7e7810f5c8]

title: npm staged publishing now supports creating new packages
Unvalidated npm trusted publishing configurations now expire
summary: Unvalidated npm trusted publishing configurations now expire 48 hours after creation and can no longer authorize publishing.[^c-70fb9140c8]

title: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
summary: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request.[^c-79e1501823] Balanced is also now the default review effort level.[^c-8f87279622]

title: Stateless GitHub App installation tokens rolled out
summary: The staged rollout of the stateless GitHub App installation token format, which began on April 27, 2026, is complete.[^c-06c36bc082] By default, all newly minted GitHub App installation tokens will be in the stateless ghs_APPID_JWT format, which makes token issuance and validation faster and improves the reliability of the GitHub API.[^c-b4234691eb]

title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
Secret scanning adds detectors for Lovable, Supabase, and more
summary: Secret scanning now detects new secret types from Lovable Labs, Pydantic Services Inc., and Supabase.[^c-5ef95c94d3]

title: Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development
Code scanning AI Scan enablement status in security overview
summary: Organization and enterprise administrators can now see AI Scan for pull requests enablement status in the security overview coverage view.[^c-edccbc069e] The code scanning summary shows enabled and not enabled repository counts, while repository rows show each repository’s effective AI Scan enablement.[^c-67f3a0b708]

title: Stacked pull requests generally available
summary: GitHub stacked pull requests are now generally available.[^c-ca68196038] Break large changes into smaller, focused pull requests that you can review independently and merge together.[^c-0d5dceb48c]

title: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
summary: If your Copilot usage metrics have shown agent activity or agent lines of code falling while Copilot usage kept growing, we’ve found the cause, and a fix is rolling out to each IDE.[^c-5d6b5ea44d] Several IDEs recently moved Copilot agent sessions to the Copilot SDK.[^c-f6787d6095]

title: Discover local models in GitHub Copilot CLI
summary: GitHub Copilot CLI makes it easier to choose a local model without leaving your existing workflow.[^c-17a97916a8] Starting in CLI version 1.0.94-0, use /model to discover supported models from a running local Ollama instance, alongside your configured models and cloud models provided by GitHub Copilot.[^c-cbf3b604cf]

title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available
summary: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot is now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and VS Code sessions using Agent Host.[^c-0d0560fe0f] Local sandboxes give developers a secure execution boundary for agentic workflows on their own machines.[^c-11c3314ba6]

title: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection
summary: Secret protection should keep pace with the way you build software, whether you write code yourself or work with an AI agent.[^c-5366eeadd5] With our new purpose-built model, we’re bringing context-aware detection into more developer workflows to help you catch secrets before they’re exposed.[^c-2e5af2b444]

title: Claude Haiku 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
summary: Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic’s newest lightweight model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-8553541692]

title: Bringing local models and sandboxed tools to Windows and GitHub Copilot
summary: Coming soon, GitHub Copilot will determine when a task is best handled by on-device intelligence and when it should leverage cloud-scale models.[^c-e20ba3e884] When leveraging agents, developers need both choice and control.[^c-e599687955]

title: Copilot harness
summary: The Copilot harness adds exciting new agent functionality to VS Code.[^c-89f306ed37]

title: Keep track of background shells
summary: When the agent runs a command in the background, it keeps working on other steps while the command runs.[^c-e6e7612aa2] In Copilot harness sessions, a Background Shells pill above the chat input lists the shells that are still running, in both the Agents window and the editor window.[^c-71e986d3d5]

title: More control for agent-triggered messages
summary: When agents delegate work across conversations, they can adjust the delegated task as requirements change instead of waiting for the other session to finish.[^c-aeeb49b484]

title: Arrange sessions in a grid
summary: Compare results, monitor long-running tasks, or work across related conversations without repeatedly switching between sessions.[^c-34b1bbf83c] Like in the editor window, the two-dimensional session grid in the Agents window lets you drag sessions into horizontal or vertical splits and resize the panes.[^c-2dd8d3f335] Maximize a session when you need to focus, then return to the grid to continue working across conversations.[^c-843220ed4b]

title: Compact layout density
summary: Fit more content in the Agents window with the Compact layout density.[^c-4554e2d4d9] Compact density uses a shorter title bar, removes the gaps between workbench parts, and reduces pane spacing.[^c-af6cae6a8c]

title: Additional session-filtering options
summary: Focus your sessions list on the work you care about.[^c-b819e4abd3]

title: Track activity across nested sessions
summary: Nested sessions let you split related work across separate conversations.[^c-c725daa9ac] In the Agents window, each nested session shows its unread status and last-modified time, helping you find recent activity and conversations that need your attention without opening them individually.[^c-2a911b6b23]

title: Simplified new-session controls (Experimental)
summary: The experimental new-session composer keeps your prompt at the center while making session choices easier to review.[^c-01cf750a29] Workspace, repository, and harness controls now appear in a collapsible Session Options tray above the chat input.[^c-a644108bb8] Getting-started tips now appear in a rounded notice below the chat input, so they no longer separate the session controls from your prompt.[^c-a5a3e55aff]

title: Improved context picker positioning
summary: The Add Context picker now opens next to the button that invoked it and closes when you select the button again.[^c-54b2770214]

title: Move agent picker in context control (Experimental)
summary: If you prefer to have the Agent picker initially hidden from the chat input to reduce the number of controls, you can configure this setting to move it into the Add Context menu.[^c-29809f3389] After you select an agent, the picker returns to the chat input.[^c-de1e8f35b3]

title: Customize new-session welcome messages (Experimental)
summary: New-session welcome messages add personality to the Agents window.[^c-09ddb1fb36] In this release, you can add your own phrases to the defaults or replace the default phrases.[^c-268c065849]

title: Continue local external Copilot sessions without reloading
summary: New conversations from the Copilot CLI and GitHub Copilot app are now picked up automatically as external sessions as soon as you send the first request, even when the Agents window is already open.[^c-fad3d95206] You can open and continue these conversations directly from the Agents window.[^c-5e499ece39] Use the Created In and Created Externally filters to choose which conversations appear in the sessions list.[^c-6abd52586d]

title: Codex chat handoff between apps
summary: Pick up a Codex chat started in the ChatGPT app or Codex CLI and continue it in VS Code's Agents window on the same machine, with your conversation history intact.[^c-89e65d3db2] You can switch back to the ChatGPT app or Codex CLI later and continue the same chat.[^c-82dcee2a86] To use your GitHub Copilot subscription in VS Code, choose a Copilot model in the model picker.[^c-8f03ce3b14]

title: Download remote files from the editor
summary: Save an open remote file locally, without having to navigate for it in the Files panel.[^c-16cb7423c9] In the Agents window, open the editor's More Actions menu and select Download... to download the file to a local destination.[^c-58eca5018d]

title: Persistent progress in chat
summary: Persistent progress is rolling out to all users.[^c-70f9b02252]

title: Meet Blobby
summary: The /vscode-pet has a name: Blobby.[^c-fbb3af37ee] Type /vscode-pet in any chat in the editor or Agents window to meet Blobby.[^c-cf6d02a909]

title: See discovered MCP servers in Customizations editor (Preview)
summary: Find MCP servers supplied by plugins, extensions, and built-in integrations alongside your configured servers in the MCP Servers section of the Agent Customizations editor.[^c-543878e839] Servers discovered outside your workspace's mcp.json are visible in the UI, so you don't have to use MCP: List Servers to find them.[^c-003ad582ab] Run Chat: Open Customizations from the Command Palette and select MCP Servers to inspect the available integrations.[^c-77b0d5d736]

title: Frosted glass overlays and menus
summary: Menus, the Command Palette, and other pop-ups now use softly blurred, frosted glass backgrounds in the desktop Agents window.[^c-5f5dfdb558]

title: Spreading block pasting
summary: Paste a copied block at a single cursor to distribute its rows across successive destination lines.[^c-806f5d4681]

title: Sign in to multiple GitHub Enterprise instances
summary: Many organizations use GitHub Copilot through a GHE.com account but keep their code on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES).[^c-66e56f9f16] The github-enterprise.uri setting held a single instance, so you couldn't be signed in to both at once.[^c-c6652d1781] For example, you couldn't use Copilot with your GHE.com account and review pull requests on GHES in the same VS Code window.[^c-b58bab9659]

title: Migration of legacy VS Code policies to Agent Host managed settings
summary: The Copilot harness, powered by the Copilot SDK and running in VS Code's Agent Host, is gradually becoming the default for enterprise users who have VS Code experiments enabled.[^c-a656f4deb9] To preserve existing enterprise controls during this transition, VS Code translates supported legacy policies into unified managed settings at runtime when possible.[^c-fd4f9ea67a]

title: Use managed settings to require sandboxing (Preview)
summary: Legacy VS Code sandbox settings and device policies are deprecated.[^c-f1bf8ddae0] ChatAgentSandboxEnabled` now supplies an overridable default rather than a mandatory requirement in Agent Host.[^c-90eee95069]

title: Keep your selected agent through policy checks
Legacy VS Code sandbox settings and device policies
summary: Legacy VS Code sandbox settings and device policies are deprecated.[^c-f1bf8ddae0] ChatAgentSandboxEnabled now supplies an overridable default rather than a mandatory requirement in Agent Host.[^c-3c0c11a480]

title: How one bug bounty researcher chooses the features they investigate
Screen readers can navigate timelines as lists
summary: Screen readers can now navigate issue and pull request timelines as a list.[^c-a70cd16207] When you move through a timeline, assistive technology can announce the list structure, item count, current position, and how to move between events.[^c-9906ee8a20]

title: Draft pull requests count toward pull request limits
summary: Maintainers are seeing more low-quality contributions in their repositories and need better ways to manage them.[^c-969c9a9121] You can now configure pull request limits to also include draft pull requests.[^c-133d90ed3e] Previously, draft pull requests didn’t count toward a user’s limit.[^c-5a81334bb5]

title: Triage role users or higher can now archive pull requests
summary: Users with the triage role or higher in a repository can now archive and unarchive pull requests.[^c-47c7daa387] Previously, archiving was limited to repository administrators, requiring trusted triagers to hand routine moderation work to someone with higher permissions.[^c-b6e56c8fc5] Maintainers increasingly rely on triagers to keep pull request queues healthy without granting them permission to change code.[^c-b89b313774]

title: Copilot code review: New organization billing options and controls
summary: By default, Copilot code review bills requests associated with members who have a Copilot license to that member’s own Copilot entitlement.[^c-40148a8baa] Organization owners can now choose to bill the organization that owns the repository instead in order to avoid consuming or exhausting member quotas.[^c-94ea43e4d6]

title: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build
summary: The barriers to building software have collapsed.[^c-b553b13a45]

title: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript analysis
summary: CodeQL 2.27.2 is now available, adding a C++ regular-expression parser and analysis improvements across several languages.[^c-11150f3ad3] CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which helps you find and remediate security issues in your code.[^c-889679fed5] The Default suite runs 498 security queries covering 170 CWEs.[^c-45e285b0ea]

title: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
summary: Learn how to add custom instructions and skills to your repository, use custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright.[^c-546ec8bef0] Context matters when you’re working with AI.[^c-2bd875b3e8] Every codebase has its own house rules: how components are structured, which scripts to run, and which conventions apply to different frameworks and file types.[^c-78be161f4e]

title: Anonymous organization-level registries for Dependabot
summary: You can now select Anonymous as the authentication method for an organization-level private registry.[^c-eff5f5d5a5] Use it for registries that Dependabot can reach without credentials, such as an internal package mirror that allows anonymous reads.[^c-d7d0d22017] On github.com, Dependabot update jobs can only reach hosts on the egress allowlist and the private registries you configure.[^c-4d11359f67]

title: Push attribution for commits in limited public preview
summary: GitHub now durably records the authenticated user who pushed each commit and surfaces that pusher identity in the UI and API alongside the existing author and committer fields.[^c-ab2aed8ba9] Commit author and committer fields are just strings that the pushing client supplies, so anyone with write access to a repository can set them to any name and email they choose.[^c-292d63bd4a]

title: Client telemetry user attribution and configurable capture
summary: Enterprise administrators can now use telemetry in managed settings to attribute GitHub Copilot activity to a user without collecting their prompts, responses, or tool content.[^c-dd361b15d0]

title: Improved detection for withdrawn Dependabot alerts
summary: You can now more easily detect withdrawn Dependabot alerts.[^c-110ad650c7] Dependabot withdraws and removes an alert when the advisory or vulnerability that produced it is no longer valid.[^c-b300db578e]

title: Enterprise managed settings enforcement updates
summary: Enterprise administrators can now require supported GitHub Copilot clients to retrieve current server-managed settings at startup instead of relying on a cached policy.[^c-205d1f26f6]

title: Search and filter for budgets now available
summary: The “Budgets and alerts” page in your GitHub billing settings now shows all of your budgets in one list that you can search and filter.[^c-f5a1b2055b] Whether you manage budgets for a personal account, enterprise or organization, you can find a specific budget without paginating through the full list.[^c-dde8e2d81f]

title: Code scanning AI Scan metrics in security overview
summary: Organization and enterprise administrators can now observe the impact of AI Scan for pull requests in security overview.[^c-552933b313] New metrics show how many AI Scan findings were generated, resolved, the remediation rate, which repositories generated findings, trends over the selected reporting period, and how often developers applied autofix suggestions.[^c-87b1b9d690]

title: Secret scanning blocks Anthropic keys by default, adds Salesforce
summary: Secret scanning now detects new secret types from Salesforce, Anthropic, and Cloudsmith, with the new Anthropic secret types blocked with push protection by default.[^c-14b299e3b6]

title: Audit GitHub Code Quality finding dismissals and reopenings
summary: You can now review manual dismissals and reopenings of GitHub Code Quality findings in your organization or enterprise audit log.[^c-c7116254bc] Findings may appear in either your repository’s default-branch backlog or pull requests.[^c-725530b9b8]

title: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
summary: Gemini 4 Argon, Google’s newest frontier model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-183db17f37]

title: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers
GitHub availability report: September 2026
summary: In September, we experienced two incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.[^c-24243677c2]

title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
summary: GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are now in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans.[^c-0ae5d3e8e5] Tags and branches can move after you review a workflow, so a later run might execute different code.[^c-90691df1da] Lockfiles let you keep those references in your workflow while running the exact commits you locked.[^c-1dac3f4f17]

title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
summary: HydraFusion has an updated model pool, improved orchestration workflows, and introduces HydraFusion Max.[^c-72c5e86d08] Both HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max are available across VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, and GitHub Copilot CLI and remain in research preview.[^c-470b2c069b] HydraFusion orchestrates multiple models to produce a single response, bringing together their strengths so you don’t have to choose an individual model for each task.[^c-71b5479633]

title: New tools, new workflows and the value of the Visual Studio Subscription: What we learned at VSLive! San Diego
Copilot harness
summary: The Copilot harness is powered by the Copilot SDK, a shared foundation that helps align behavior, capabilities, and improvements across Copilot products.[^c-79a77b4dd9]

title: Canvases (Preview)
summary: Canvases are interactive interfaces to collaborate with an agent.[^c-9ad41e8f5f] A canvas opens beside the chat, where you and the agent can inspect and update the same artifact instead of coordinating solely through prompts.[^c-04f2627667] For example, use a Kanban canvas to plan and track implementation work.[^c-7297c36fc7]

title: Move chats between folders and worktrees
Session-scoped layout in the Agents window (Experimental)
Customize the Agents window panel layout
summary: You can now choose how the bottom panel is aligned in the Agents window.[^c-fa0cf6770a]

title: Stop background shells
summary: In Copilot harness sessions, the background shells pill above the chat input lists the commands that the agent is still running in the background.[^c-89495b14d6] When one of those commands is no longer useful, for example a test run that you want to restart or a command that runs longer than expected, you can stop it instead of waiting for it to finish.[^c-b3ea3f77c0]

title: Stateful responses for BYOK custom endpoints
summary: If your bring-your-own-key (BYOK) model uses a stateless Responses API, set "statefulResponses": false on its model entry in chatLanguageModels.json to send full conversation history with each request.[^c-58f1f4d430] See Custom Endpoint configuration for details.[^c-d5aa647d5b]

title: Windows sandboxing for Local harness is no longer supported
summary: Windows sandboxing for terminal commands in Local agent sessions has been deprecated.[^c-17e9083a33] For sandboxed command execution on Windows, use an Agent Host session.[^c-eccfc4584e] See the Agent Host sandboxing documentation for details.[^c-93d55afd37]

title: Redesigned model picker
summary: Copilot and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) providers offer many models, each with strengths for different tasks.[^c-47d09548e2] The redesigned model picker makes it easier to choose and switch models as your work changes.[^c-985194e4a8] The model picker uses a tabbed interface to separate Copilot and BYOK models.[^c-918fbf23c2]

title: Editing mode closer to the Markdown source
summary: When you edit Markdown, each source line appears on a separate visual line, making the document structure easier to follow.[^c-c004df28e2] Read-only mode continues to render Markdown as before.[^c-f52f7448e1]

title: Outline and breadcrumbs
summary: The Markdown editor integrates with the Outline view and breadcrumbs, making it easier to inspect the heading structure and jump to a section.[^c-828865ae1a]

title: Copy code blocks
summary: Like the Markdown preview, code blocks in the Markdown editor display a copy button on hover.[^c-8e4e7f5b10]

title: Merging document highlights from different providers
Automatically move policy-managed chats to Copilot Agent Host
summary: Enterprise managed settings let administrators govern agent permissions and sandboxing.[^c-0bfb62db3f]

title: Windows numeric policies support DWORD values
summary: On Windows, policies that accept numeric values support DWORDs and QWORDs.[^c-7d4981b89b]

title: Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org
summary: Put native GitHub features to work to review outside collaborator access and archive stale repositories.[^c-e2fe1cd17f] Working with outside collaborators can add more work for a repository owner.[^c-7d4db09e82] You need to confirm who still needs access, change permissions as projects evolve, and archive repositories once they’ve served their purpose.[^c-72a2e94a15]

title: The next developer interface is ambient intelligence
summary: AI, agents, voice, and physical controls are shifting software development from operating tools to expressing intent—and helping developers stay focused on building.[^c-705865f586]

title: Email notifications for repository push events have been retired
summary: As of October 15, 2026, email notifications for repository push events have been retired and are no longer sent.[^c-051d2b416c]

title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability
summary: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts is now generally available.[^c-434ca799d5]

title: AI Scan for pull requests generally available
summary: Code scanning AI Scan for pull requests is now generally available.[^c-764270f5ff]

title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-November
Download GitHub Code Quality license usage as a CSV
summary: You can now download a CSV report of your GitHub Code Quality license usage to reconcile your license count with your own records.[^c-913d3a8024]

title: Multi-repository support and other improvements for GitHub in Slack and Teams
Xcode 27 runner image generally available
summary: You can now use the generally available Xcode 27 runner image to build and test your Apple applications in GitHub Actions.[^c-ae2a2ccf6b] Previously in public preview, this GitHub-hosted image runs on macOS 27 and includes the Xcode 27 toolchain and Apple SDKs.[^c-21ed201806]

title: Fortune Telling and Speculative Design, For Fun and Profit
summary: How design engineers can explore possible software futures, with a look at how GitHub Next builds and tests its bets.[^c-a759290342] A practical toolkit for spotting weak signals, tracing second-order effects, and making theories tangible through prototypes and artefacts from the future.[^c-4e4ca8bd38]

title: Stop waiting on a failed build
Open source license compliance generally available
summary: Enterprises can now manage their dependencies’ licenses at scale with sophisticated, ruleset-based checks that enforce a centralized policy.[^c-c968505c21] Open source license compliance is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers, including data-resident GHEC, for repositories with GitHub Code Security enabled.[^c-4582b1317c]

title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
summary: Learn how to move an agent session from the GitHub Copilot app into VS Code without losing the conversation, code changes, or working context.[^c-d12f622011] The agent has finished the bulk of your change.[^c-47795895e2] Now you want to inspect one implementation detail, adjust a few lines by hand, and run the project locally before you ship it.[^c-450ba21f7f]

title: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
summary: During periods of unusual traffic, GitHub may temporarily require authentication for some clones and fetches of public repositories over HTTPS to help protect github.com’s availability.[^c-1ddb5d52d4] If an operation is affected, it will fail with a message indicating that authentication is required.[^c-ada99b17e1] To continue, authenticate and retry the operation.[^c-4219f1dc21]

title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
summary: Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, Apple no longer includes Intel (x86_64) code in some of the system binaries and libraries that CodeQL relies on to trace builds.[^c-cfdf732fdf] As a result, CodeQL can’t support traced scans on these versions or analyze Swift 6.4.[^c-c39b868693]

title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026
summary: As of today, October 19, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).[^c-6d1b4d974f]

title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
summary: You can now use the REST API to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, agent apps, and organizations.[^c-2871742785]

title: Organize and revisit tabs with the keyboard
How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity
summary: Three Java Champions share how they use GitHub Copilot to solve problems, accelerate development, and keep humans responsible for the results.[^c-71a29a8e13] AI coding tools can generate code quickly, but speed alone does not solve the hardest software engineering problems.[^c-3dfcc6d92d] Developers still need to provide context, validate results, protect maintainability, and remain accountable for what ships.[^c-6b4e3cd6d5]

title: GitHub package firewall in public preview
summary: There’s been a recent flood of malware attacks that exploit systems at package installation time.[^c-31932d701f] Agents and CI runners are particularly vulnerable to these attacks because they install dependencies to accomplish a task or complete a build without a human in the loop.[^c-703973cd82] To stem this tide, GitHub is introducing a new package firewall, which sits between endpoints or internal registries and the upstream package repositories.[^c-8a0c7f8d54]

title: Dependabot now supports npm 12, pnpm 11 and 12, and Bun 1.4
summary: You can now upgrade your projects to npm 12, pnpm 11 or 12, or Bun 1.4 and keep receiving Dependabot updates.[^c-0b172295f5] Support for these package manager versions is available to all github.com users and will be included in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.[^c-d3d1feef81]

title: Dependabot alerts REST API now includes dependency versions
summary: You can now get the version of a vulnerable dependency directly from Dependabot alert responses in the REST API.[^c-93cf3a0050] Each alert’s dependency object includes a new version_requirement field with the version or version constraint that Dependabot last recorded for the alert.[^c-1965c13ba0] Alert responses already included the advisory’s vulnerable version range, but not the version in your repository.[^c-c5c2002ba6]

title: Bulk migrate branch protections to rulesets for a repository
summary: You can now convert all branch protection rules of a repository to rulesets in a single action.[^c-c760e85bb9]

title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
summary: You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview.[^c-32f14ace15] When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a rotating refresh token and automatically refreshes the token whenever it is needed.[^c-ce732ce952] You stay authenticated without reauthenticating, and a leaked access token becomes unusable within hours instead of lasting indefinitely.[^c-c1ad9c2936]

title: Compare today’s code with an earlier commit
Copilot harness as the default
summary: The Copilot harness is now the default for new sessions in VS Code.[^c-94ce8c11a4]

title: Discard changes from more changesets in the Agents window
summary: The Changes view in the Agents window lets you see all the modifications made by the agent.[^c-d2d6207d07] Until now, discarding pending changes was only available in the Uncommitted Changes changeset.[^c-bf59bf2d59]

title: Compare model results (Preview)
summary: Compare how different models and harnesses approach the same coding task.[^c-fcacd82ecc] Run attempts in parallel, review their results, and combine ideas into one solution.[^c-dd889a796c]

title: Tab shortcuts in an empty side pane
summary: When you closed every tab in the Agents window side pane, the editor area was left blank, and you had to find the Add Tab (+) menu to get back to your session's changes or files.[^c-4aad1857c8]

title: Find and create files from the empty Files tab (Experimental)
summary: In the Agents window, the Files tab was blank when no file was open, so you had to switch to the Files view to find or create a file in your session's folder.[^c-27992913cc]

title: Improved performance when opening large chats
summary: Opening a long Agent Host chat in the Agents window used to freeze the window for up to half a minute while the chat's history was restored.[^c-48690aa2c4] In this release, history is restored in small slices instead of one long blocking task, so the window stays responsive.[^c-eb3281be89] Opening, switching back to, and reloading large chats is significantly faster.[^c-5b6cdff0c0]

title: Reclaim storage from inactive worktrees (Experimental)
summary: Worktrees are very useful for letting agents work on multiple features simultaneously without interfering with each other's changes.[^c-72aac53500] Over time, inactive worktrees can accumulate and consume significant disk space.[^c-ab295a15fb] Run Chat: Open Worktree Cleanup from the Command Palette to see how much disk space inactive agent session worktrees use and remove the ones you no longer need.[^c-a6f88b70c8]

title: Run Copilot models on your device (Experimental)
Bring your own OpenAI model to Voice Mode (Preview)
Manage sandbox certificate trust
summary: Sandbox certificate trust management is available for agent hosts running Windows or macOS.[^c-1ae176345e] The sandbox credential proxy lets tools authenticate to approved services without exposing real authentication tokens to sandboxed processes.[^c-4d6486115e]

title: Change session sandboxing when policy permits
summary: If your organization's managed policy permits sandbox bypass, you can turn sandboxing off for an individual Copilot harness session without changing your global settings.[^c-edad3b9b86] Use the Sandboxing for terminal toggle in the session permissions menu in either the editor or the Agents window.[^c-6fb711cbea] Administrators can continue to require sandboxing by disallowing bypass, which keeps the toggle on and locked.[^c-2bf9de9add]

title: Open canvases from the chat menu (Preview)
summary: VS Code 1.142 introduced canvases (Preview), which are shared, interactive surfaces for collaborating with agents.[^c-44672c15a9] In this release, you can now open available canvases from New Chat (+) > Canvas in the editor window, without asking Copilot to open them.[^c-aaeed8809e] When canvas support is enabled and you have canvas extensions installed, the submenu appears _after your first message_ in a Copilot harness session.[^c-176bc122f3]

title: See output from detached background shells
summary: In Copilot harness sessions, the agent can start commands that need to continue running after it responds in a detached background shell.[^c-29143cb919] A dev server or a file watcher are common examples of such commands.[^c-e2ab1def89] Previously, you couldn't view the output of detached background shells, for example to check whether a dev server started successfully.[^c-7f3011e08d]

title: Multi-file diff editor file list (Experimental)
summary: Navigate changes from commits, stashes, and agent sessions with a file list beside the multi-file diff view.[^c-a6dab1b11d]

title: Dynamic headers for managed OpenTelemetry
summary: Administrators can generate and refresh HTTP headers for OpenTelemetry (OTel) exports with the new telemetry.headersProvider managed setting.[^c-2643185f16] For example, use a helper to supply short-lived authentication tokens for your collector, without asking developers to update headers manually or opt in through personal OTel settings.[^c-320d4ec620]

title: Fewer interruptions while organization settings load
summary: Copilot harness sessions and model changes now wait for slow organization settings to load, with progress and a retry option on failure.[^c-58bcebd1d8] You can still select Stop while you're waiting.[^c-5c83ffb776] Organization restrictions apply before requests run.[^c-01afb34a0d]

title: Fewer approval prompts for managed tools
summary: Assisted permissions no longer prompt again for eligible managed tool requests they approve.[^c-a23b0082e6] One-time limits, managed denials, and sandbox restrictions still apply.[^c-f3e5834ab6]

title: Managed plugins install automatically
summary: Copilot harness sessions now install or update the agent plugins that your organization requires before using them.[^c-8a31de162a]

title: Claude and Codex sessions
summary: When policy requires the Copilot harness, existing Claude and Codex sessions remain visible in the sessions list, so you still can continue them with the Copilot harness.[^c-cad4aae888] Creating new Claude or Codex sessions remains disabled in this scenario.[^c-6d87b866c1]

title: Install GitHub Copilot CLI with VS Code
How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills
summary: As home to the world’s developers, GitHub is dedicated to the security and reliability of the code behind millions of projects, and our Bug Bounty Program remains a cornerstone of that commitment.[^c-8d92818532] Collaboration with external researchers is one of the most effective ways to improve security, and every year, the community helps us identify and fix vulnerabilities that make the platform safer for everyone.[^c-a6d7973432]

title: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
summary: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes an “Industry comparison” section.[^c-8704e7f581] Enterprises, and organizations that aren’t owned by an enterprise, can compare their Copilot agentic adoption and leverage with aggregated benchmarks from participating peers.[^c-3c4c1c00d4] Participation is opt-in and disabled by default.[^c-2196f2549f]

title: Pull requests: Saved whitespace preferences and improved split view
Public monitoring now available with data residency
summary: Public monitoring is now available in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHEC DR).[^c-1b9be3186d]

title: Meta API endpoints updated for Actions blob storage
Global default for Copilot features generally available
summary: In September, we announced a global default policy for generally available GitHub Copilot features and supported client capabilities on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.[^c-5f1865314b] Starting today, we’re gradually rolling out enforcement of the policy through October 26, so it may take effect at different times for different enterprises and organizations.[^c-b90784dcb6]

title: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in usage metrics API
GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — September update
summary: September 2026 brought deeper visibility into your work: explore pull requests without leaving chat, bring the AI model your team trusts, and fix vulnerable packages the moment Visual Studio flags them.[^c-2be26a4640]

title: Enterprise installations for GitHub Apps generally available
summary: Installing GitHub Apps on your enterprise is now generally available.[^c-ed77c3c0d0] You can replace classic PATs with GitHub Apps in more of your enterprise and organization automation with the expanded API support detailed below.[^c-782c9828a0]

title: Public monitoring adds triage, validity, API, and webhooks
summary: Public monitoring now includes alert management capabilities like automatic validity checks to help you triage and remediate leaked secrets at scale.[^c-ba34983d7a]

title: EMU deletions fix
summary: Between June 1 and June 13, 2026, some Enterprise Managed User accounts that were deprovisioned through SCIM were incorrectly deleted instead of being suspended and obfuscated as expected.[^c-4119081703] As a result, affected users appeared as ghost users in issues, pull requests, and audit logs, rather than retaining their expected suspended and obfuscated user records within the enterprise.[^c-f41d38706c]

title: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
summary: The new GitHub app in Teams brings notifications and Copilot together, helping teams turn issues into fixes and ship code faster without leaving the conversation.[^c-caf6424d41] Get notified in channels, group chats, or private chats, then @mention GitHub to turn updates into action.[^c-8180449f56]

title: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports.[^c-d3016abef3] A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.[^c-d73718bed4]

title: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
summary: GPT-6.1 Terra, OpenAI’s newest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-ea02b51aeb]

title: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
summary: Assisted permissions are now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code.[^c-b6d43feb69] When Copilot requests permission to run a command, access a file system path, or open a URL, a large language model evaluates the request.[^c-914355fc20] Requests classified as clearly safe automatically proceed.[^c-72911cba36]

title: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
summary: GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, available in public preview.[^c-5d1ea108cf] Services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK can now make requests on behalf of an organization without relying on a signed-in user’s credentials.[^c-99629632b6]

title: Visual Studio October Update – Compare Commits to Your Code, Resolve Conflicts in Bulk, Keep Coding
Tune GitHub Copilot inline suggestions with configurable eagerness
summary: Choose how proactively Copilot offers inline suggestions.[^c-2c2f78fc07] A helpful suggestion at the wrong moment can still feel like an interruption.[^c-7ca43dff95] When you're completing a familiar pattern, you may want Copilot to anticipate several changes ahead.[^c-1490be5577]

title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack
summary: Today, we laid out our vision for GitHub as the most comprehensive, end-to-end software delivery system in the world.[^c-d888f50950]

title: Prioritize Dependabot alerts with reachability analysis
summary: Dependabot alerts can add up faster than a team can work through them.[^c-cbfa29ec2f] A vulnerable package in your dependency tree doesn’t always mean your code uses the vulnerable part of it, so knowing whether it does gives you more context when deciding where to start.[^c-9f99123c2f] Reachability analysis for Dependabot, now in public preview for JavaScript and TypeScript, adds that context to your alerts.[^c-0f5b5c9127]

title: Introducing Replica, an open-source AI prototyping tool
GitHub Copilot Fusion now supports selection of local models
summary: Today we are shipping intelligent routing for local models into experimental preview.[^c-1f07d5b0c1] GitHub Copilot Fusion can now choose between supported on-device models and cloud models, enabling intelligent local model routing in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code.[^c-67199c6671]

title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Universe releases
Generate and edit images directly in Copilot
summary: You can now generate and edit images using natural language in GitHub Copilot.[^c-a995736cbb] When you ask for an image, your selected reasoning model calls a dedicated image-generation tool powered by GPT Image 2.5 Flare, previews the result inline, and saves it to your project.[^c-38110eaf88]

title: Work from anywhere with a new, connected Copilot cloud experience
summary: Copilot is now one connected experience in the cloud.[^c-0492babc70] Start a cloud task wherever you are, on github.com, GitHub Mobile, the Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, VS Code, or right from a conversation in Slack or Microsoft Teams.[^c-0ea9efd3b5] Then pick it up wherever you work next.[^c-0b190e4262]

title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, Universe releases
Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
summary: GitHub Copilot Fusion is generally available.[^c-3d3ea9e7fc] Instead of picking a model for each task, choose Copilot Fusion and let Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate which models it uses for you.[^c-0e04cd40de] Copilot Fusion brings together Project HydraFusion’s multi-model orchestration and Copilot auto model selection’s fine-tuned model selection, leveraging the benefits of both to balance performance and cost efficiency.[^c-613e3beae6]

title: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app
summary: You can now work through your repository’s GitHub code scanning alerts without leaving the GitHub Copilot app.[^c-8e42c869db] The new GitHub security extension, now in public preview, lets you find the alerts that matter most and ask Copilot to explain or help fix them.[^c-20de4c1216] Until now, fixing a code scanning alert meant switching between the alert on github.com and the code in your editor.[^c-5ef6f43d18]

title: AI Scan for repositories in public preview
summary: You can now use AI Scan to find vulnerabilities across your whole repository, not just in pull request changes.[^c-7869da39b0]

title: Code scanning for AI applications in public preview
summary: Code scanning can now detect AI applications and agent vulnerabilities, including indirect prompt injection (XPIA), sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and other AI-specific risks as coverage expands.[^c-552ae92032] Scans automatically run on pull requests.[^c-459a45f3fb]

title: Push protection beyond predefined secret patterns
summary: GitHub push protection is expanding beyond secrets with predefined formats.[^c-fce850566a] Developed in collaboration with Microsoft Applied Sciences, our new purpose-built classifier evaluates how potential secrets are used in surrounding code, allowing GitHub to block secrets even without a known and recognizable format.[^c-0c6faca42b]

title: Public monitoring for enterprises generally available
summary: GitHub public monitoring alerts enterprises when their secrets are publicly exposed anywhere on GitHub, helping teams respond quickly to leaks wherever they happen.[^c-0ecd78d0ef]

title: Issue artifacts are now in public preview
summary: Issue artifacts attach agent-generated outputs and other important context directly to an issue.[^c-21753b6ccc] By keeping plans, research, links, and visualizations alongside the work, they give coding agents richer context and teams a durable record as the work evolves.[^c-8fbadfbe6a]

title: GitHub Actions adds multi-cloud compute to improve reliability
Pull request limits: Exempt contributors by age or history
summary: Pull request limits help maintainers manage the volume of incoming contributions from people without write access.[^c-713efc8215] You can now add exemption rules to decide which contributors can open pull requests beyond the cap, balancing protection from high-volume or low-trust contributions with fewer barriers for established community members.[^c-42f3a82fca]

title: GitHub Copilot app, Universe releases
summary: Work doesn’t always fit in a single repository or session.[^c-ab65032779] A feature can span several repositories.[^c-4d5357c97f] A launch plan can pull in specs, designs, and assets without touching a repository at all.[^c-9e090a5bee]

title: Connect your tools to Copilot without all the setup
summary: The context your agent needs is often outside your repository: a thread in Slack, a design in Figma, an error in Sentry.[^c-4ebd152a08] Until now, giving Copilot that context meant finding a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, setting up a sign-in, and repeating that in each tool you use.[^c-5601284145] GitHub-verified MCP servers, or connectors, are rolling out in public preview.[^c-36eac2830b]

title: GitHub intelligence puts your code, context, and history to work
summary: Agents should understand more than your codebase—they should understand how your team works.[^c-dd12da8be0] Your preferences, repository conventions, skills, and custom instructions guide how changes should be made, while code in related repositories can show how the pieces fit together.[^c-b0bb5a6e9e] Without that context, agents spend time rediscovering knowledge and can miss your team’s conventions.[^c-4f0d131b36]

title: Build shared workflows for your team with Copilot Automations
summary: Shared Copilot Automations are rolling out, enabling teams to build and maintain AI-powered workflows together.[^c-dca25e510d] With Copilot Automations, you can combine prompts, triggers, and tools to design workflows around the way your team works.[^c-97909cb223] Copilot runs autonomously in the cloud, using only the tools you’ve allowed.[^c-31ba381a4a]

title: New tools, triggers, and cost controls for Copilot Automations
summary: With Copilot Automations, you can combine prompts, triggers, and tools to design workflows around the way your team works.[^c-88831a322f] Triggers define when your automation runs (e.g., “every day at 9am” or “when a pull request is opened”).[^c-188f272629] Tools define what your automation can do (e.g., “update issue labels” or “create pull request”).[^c-14960b8780]

title: Copilot Automations now learn from outcomes and self-improve
summary: Copilot Automations can now learn from their outcomes and propose improvements to themselves, helping them produce better results over time.[^c-5a72e35de3]

title: Create and manage Copilot Automations in Visual Studio Code
summary: Copilot Automations in Visual Studio Code can now run in the cloud.[^c-3207839208] You can create and manage cloud automations from the Agents window without leaving your editor.[^c-8bd0f371b8] With Copilot Automations, you combine prompts, triggers, and tools to design workflows around the way you work.[^c-54f74000f6]

title: Agent Merge watches and fixes pull requests in the cloud
summary: With Agent Merge, Copilot watches your pull request and automatically fixes blockers, (e.g., failing Actions workflows and merge conflicts) that stand in the way of getting your pull request merged.[^c-7c5f445e8a] Already available in the GitHub Copilot app and Visual Studio Code, Agent Merge is now integrated into pull requests on GitHub.[^c-add0667213]

title: Copilot code review: Merge with confidence with Max and approvals
summary: GitHub Copilot code review now offers its most thorough review and can approve your pull request when it’s ready to merge.[^c-eff22d4ace] The new Max review effort level is now in public preview, and Copilot approvals are generally available.[^c-b9060fa505] Together, they turn a high-quality review into a high-confidence approval, so you can merge with confidence and spend less time waiting on review.[^c-bce897b308]

title: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
summary: Enterprises working with a GitHub or Microsoft account team can now get Copilot included with GitHub Enterprise for every licensed user.[^c-a05d9aa946] Previously, you had to manage two things: how many Copilot seats you were paying for and how much AI usage those users consumed.[^c-5115138426] With Copilot included in the platform, usage against your enterprise budget is the primary thing to manage.[^c-8020097d42]

title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles are generally available
summary: You can now use GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles in general availability on GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans.[^c-3d4d3ebccb] Lockfiles let you keep readable tag and branch references in your workflows while running the exact commits you locked, even if those references move.[^c-c6f985df09]

title: Moderate role for GitHub Issues generally available
summary: The Moderate role will be available in the coming weeks.[^c-38d1c36658]

title: GitHub Copilot SDK is becoming Microsoft Copilot SDK
Repository plugin defaults and enterprise plugin controls generally available
summary: Repository plugin defaults and enterprise-managed plugin controls are now generally available in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app.[^c-5269d84119] Trusted repositories can install and enable default plugins for contributors.[^c-1d5dead58a] Enterprises can require plugins, block plugins, and restrict installation to approved marketplaces.[^c-fe5a4fe2f1]

title: Manage remote environments
summary: VS Code lets you run agents and perform development tasks across different (remote) environments.[^c-9f592a5a9a] To make it easier to manage these environments, we're introducing the Remote Environments dialog, which brings your GitHub Environments, Dev Tunnels, WSL distributions, and SSH hosts together in one place.[^c-f69fc0d54d]

title: Compare models and harnesses by default and in more projects
summary: Model comparisons run the same prompt across models for side-by-side review.[^c-5a23c80648]

title: Let agents use desktop apps with computer use
summary: Some tasks happen in desktop apps rather than in your code or the terminal.[^c-3509cff9de] With Computer Use, the agent can see and control apps on your computer.[^c-66b1e16ff2] Computer Use works in Copilot harness sessions that run on your own macOS or Windows machine.[^c-39edcae1c0]

title: Session composer controls (Experimental)
summary: Starting a new agent session is something you do often, so we've grouped the key settings at the top and added shortcuts for quick access.[^c-9260523ad5]

title: Copilot Memory in the Copilot harness
Manage worktree storage (Experimental)
summary: Last release, we introduced worktree storage cleanup for agent sessions to help you reclaim disk space used by worktrees.[^c-c61814e6c7]

title: Enable extensions in agents window
summary: Extensions can run and be enabled or disabled directly from the Agents window.[^c-b62fe39775]

title: GitHub Environments
summary: There is a new option for sharing your local agents with your other devices.[^c-26d3f8c158] The radio tower button in the upper right corner of the agents window previously shared your local agents over dev tunnels, but now you have the option to share with GitHub Environments as well.[^c-a8e5242e4e]

title: Discover marketplace customizations (Preview)
summary: Add skills, tools, and entire workflows to your agent without building them from scratch.[^c-60525ac709]

title: Richer editing for GitHub Copilot custom agents
Harness-aware defaults for custom agent editing
summary: When your .agent.md file has no target attribute, the editor now uses the active customization harness to provide matching completions, hovers, and diagnostics.[^c-3437eb12b6] Switching harnesses refreshes this guidance without reopening the file.[^c-b0dc831edc] An explicit target: vscode or target: github-copilot continues to override the default.[^c-494c9c01c7]

title: Share links to plugins and customizations
Manage Copilot customizations with slash commands
summary: You can manage plugins, MCP servers, and skills without leaving the Chat view in a Copilot harness session.[^c-b0546b4516]

title: Move chats between sessions (Preview)
summary: The Agents window lets you organize related conversations into sessions.[^c-47da083007]

title: Choose a workspace for nested sessions
Nested sessions in quick chats
summary: Follow up on a quick chat without mixing separate questions into one conversation or losing track of related discussions.[^c-95968c5824] For example, explore two approaches in separate nested sessions under the same quick chat, without opening a project folder.[^c-396fed73fd] Quick chats in the Agents window support nested sessions: select + on a quick chat or use New Nested Session from its context menu.[^c-c98fe6282a]

title: Custom icons and colors for session groups
summary: Make workspace groups, environment groups (including remote hosts), and custom groups easier to recognize with custom icons and theme-aware colors.[^c-c584f018b8]

title: Localized voice approvals and clearer connection status (Experimental)
Issue Reporter
summary: Issues with clear steps, screenshots, and logs are faster for us to reproduce and fix.[^c-3a82f514ad]

title: Dialogs from terminal commands open in front of VS Code on Windows
summary: On Windows, some command-line tools open dialogs that could appear behind VS Code when run from the terminal.[^c-02bb6a01d3] For example, the Azure PowerShell Connect-AzAccount sign-in picker opened behind the VS Code window, so the command looked stuck until you moved or minimized VS Code.[^c-ca7341c28e] VS Code now makes the window that shows each local terminal the owner of that terminal's hidden console window, as Windows Terminal does.[^c-98d76d5920]

title: Clearer permission restrictions
summary: Assisted and Allow All remain visible but disabled when restricted by your organization, with an explanation instead of disappearing.[^c-8fe68538fb]

title: Organization-managed session defaults
summary: New chats in the Editor and Agents windows respect your organization's default model, Copilot Fusion tier, and permission level, taking precedence over remembered selections.[^c-60b5c2226d] You can change these defaults within a session where policy allows; unavailable permission modes fall back to Manual.[^c-379f5e7388]

title: Managed settings loading progress
summary: When organization settings load slowly, progress appears inline in the waiting chat instead of stacking notification toasts.[^c-21e41893f6] Background loading no longer interrupts you.[^c-2e5849d25d]

title: Webhook IP ranges added to the Meta API
GitHub Universe 2026: Highlights from the developer’s developer conference
summary: The hero at the heart of the two-day event was the developer community.[^c-20d34c25df] From the menus at Mo’s Diner to the badge hack station to major product ships, GitHub Universe 2026 delivered.[^c-ef4b003935] The annual Octoverse report came out, showing just how much the platform has scaled over the past year in the face of agentic software delivery.[^c-5d1c07752b]

title: Universe 2026: What’s Next with GitHub Next
summary: Idan Gazit and Maggie Appleton present multiplayer agents, collaborative planning, and proof-driven development as new foundations for GitHub.[^c-491ae38e0a]
